message: Hey John, how's Alex doing? I noticed this boy seemed a bit down. Anything going on?

ohn, I urgently need to talk to someone, and you're the only one I can trust with this. Last Thursday night, I was involved in a car accident on my way back from work. Thankfully, I wasn't hurt, but the other driver was injured, and it's all I've been able to think about since. The whole experience has left me shaken, and I find myself reliving those moments constantly. It's been really tough to process this on my own...
Reminder: Environmental Science Club meeting tomorrow at 4 PM in room 202. We'll be finalizing the project topics.
Are we still on for Pixel Haven this weekend? Can't wait to beat your high score!
Morning, John! Hope you have a great day at school. Love you!
Thanks for listening, John. I don't know what I'd do without you. Let's talk more at school.
Great job on the presentation, team! Let's keep the momentum going for our project!
Hey, did you finish the math homework? I'm stuck on problem 5.
Don't forget to do your chores before you go out with friends tomorrow. Responsibility first!
I'm looking forward to the arcade, it'll be a good distraction. Thanks for inviting me.
